fusions.name: Spinning Entrencher
fusions.desc: Throws the sharpened blade, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Put Under the Sod
fusions.desc: A finishing cut that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Whetted Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharp on Both Sides
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
